title: Reserve trie overflow headroom and cover burst-first cross-root insertion order
outcome: Pending workspace trie overflow avoids unnecessary shared-ancestor widening when a full burst is followed by the first notification in a different branch, without losing coverage or exceeding fixed storage limits.
acceptance: A deterministic burst-first/new-branch regression exercises near-budget insertion and asserts bounded storage and complete exact-or-covering delivery.
An independently reviewed policy reduces unnecessary shared-ancestor widening or explicitly demonstrates why the retained workload requires it, with bounded callback work.
